Home Contact

Get in touch.

The form below reaches a real human in our Geneva office, usually within one business day. Respondents are available in English, العربية (Arabic), 日本語 (Japanese), French, and German. If your matter is urgent, please phone the Geneva office directly: +41 22 555 0123.

Send a message

All fields are required unless marked optional. We will reply in your preferred language.

First and family name. As you would like to be addressed.
We will not share your address. Replies usually arrive within one business day.
Include country code, e.g. +41 22 555 0123.
If you are writing on behalf of one.
Helps route your message to the right team.
We will reply in this language.
A one-line summary, ≤ 120 characters.
You may write in any language; if it is not one of our five working languages, please indicate it and we will arrange translation. Sample greetings: السلام عليكم, こんにちは, Guten Tag, Bonjour.
